description: TO_DATE / TRY_TO_DATE parsing: an explicit Snowflake format is honoured and an ISO string parses without one, where the format argument used to be ignored. A numeric argument is a Unix epoch ONLY under the DATE() spelling - live-verified, TO_DATE(1631711999) and TRY_TO_DATE(1631711999) both fail "invalid type [TO_DATE(1631711999)] for parameter 'TO_DATE'" while the DATE() alias of the very same function reads the epoch, and a numeric STRING is fine either way. TRY_TO_DATE answers NULL on unparseable text. Converted 1:1 from functions/ToDateTest (now retired); the Java compared LocalDate toString values, which TO_VARCHAR reproduces.
